title: Two-World Architecture (Game World + Render World)
description: UzEngine separates game state from GPU state via two parallel worlds: (1) Game World — EnTT registry with Components driving gameplay logic (SceneComponent, StaticMeshComponent, LightComponent, etc.), (2) Render World — flat RenderProxy pool with POD structs optimized for GPU submission (no virtual dispatch). Single sync point per frame via SyncToRenderWorld() bridges them. Both use generational handles for use-after-free prevention. This enables future multi-threading: game thread mutates World, render thread reads RenderWorld.
whenToUse: When adding new renderable component types. When implementing culling, LOD, or visibility systems. When planning multi-threaded rendering.
whenNotToUse: For non-rendered components (input, AI, scripts) — they only exist in Game World.
